title: Round 4 M1 chain replay plan (2026-11-18)
claim: No M1 theorem is claimed. A replayed theory is a fresh HOL run of a committed script; it is not an end-to-end proof.
budget_starts: first command in commands.json (the upstream dry run)

upstream_builds_allowed_by_coordinator.reason: The tool tree lacks objects that the chain imports. rebuild.py never listed them. The coordinator allowed these builds: recorded or obvious Holmake target, -n dry run first, -j1, new files only, stop if an existing built file would be rebuilt.

path_and_environment_changes: Holmake -j 2 -> -j1; nice -n 15; every long command under caffeinate -i -s

restored as new folders under original names: results/refund-native-audit-2026-11-04, results/refund-target-install-bridge-2026-11-05 (accepted by the coordinator)
new Forge folder forge_refundArm8Proof_experiment holds only its recorded Holmakefile; it is the recorded cwd of two cases
